column8: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Apps;         DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #JCMovedDate;           /*=========================================================           STEP 1 : GET BASE ELIGIBLE APPLICATIONS         =========================================================*/          SELECT             a.App_Id,             a.App_DisplayId,             a.App_Status,             a.GBA,             a.GBAId,             a.App_MotherEPID,             a.App_Source,              ofi.BtoA_RoadId,             ofi.BtoA_RoadName,              ksr.Road_ID,             ksr.Road_Name,             ksr.GuidanceValueSqMt,              /* EPID Metadata */             b.MD_Zonename,             b.MD_WardName,             b.MD_SiteArea,             b.MD_ZoneId,             b.MD_WardId,             b.MD_StreetId,              /* Officer Details */             o.Ofcr_IsGovtProperty,             o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue,             o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeId,             o.Ofcr_RoadFacingSides,             o.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType          INTO #Apps          FROM dbo.BtoAMainApp a          INNER JOIN dbo.BtoA_EPIDMetaData b             ON b.MD_APP_ID = a.App_Id          INNER JOIN         (             SELECT                 Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId,                 Ofcr_IsGovtProperty,                 Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue,                 Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeId,                 Ofcr_RoadFacingSides,                 ResidentialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt,                 CommercialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt,                 IndustrialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt,                 KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType             FROM dbo.BtoA_MainApp_Officer         ) o             ON o.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId = a.App_Id          INNER JOIN dbo.BtoA_SiteRoadDetails_Officer ofi             ON ofi.BtoA_MainAppId = a.App_Id          INNER JOIN masterDB_prod.dbo.MstRoadKSRAC ksr             ON ofi.BtoA_RoadId = ksr.Road_ID          /* JC Officer eligibility */         INNER JOIN masterDB_prod.dbo.mst_officer ofc             ON b.MD_ZoneId = ofc.Ofcr_ZoneId          WHERE             a.App_Active = 1             AND a.App_Status in (14,1000)             AND ofc.Ofcr_RoleId = 125             AND ofc.Ofcr_Active = 1             AND a.App_Source = 'newkhata'             AND b.MD_SiteArea >= 50             AND b.MD_SiteArea <= 1000             AND ISNULL(ofi.IsRMPPropersed, 'N') = 'N'             AND ksr.GuidanceValueSqMt IS NOT NULL 			AND a.App_JCMovedDate is not null             AND a.App_JCMovedDate < DATEADD(DAY, -13, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))             AND ofc.Ofcr_Id NOT IN (65, 11240, 11241)             AND ISNULL(a.IsApp_PropertyVerificationRequired, 0) = 0          /*=========================================================           ROAD-WIDENING AREA VALIDATION         =========================================================*/          AND         (             /* Commercial */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeId = 1                 AND ISNULL(o.CommercialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt, 0) > 5             )              OR              /* Residential */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeId = 2                 AND ISNULL(o.ResidentialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt, 0) > 5             )              OR              /* Mixed - BOTH areas must be greater than 5 */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeId = 3                 AND ISNULL(o.CommercialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt, 0) > 5                 AND ISNULL(o.ResidentialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt, 0) > 5             )              OR              /* Industrial */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeId = 4                 AND ISNULL(o.IndustrialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt, 0) > 5             )         )          /*=========================================================           PROPERTY USE TYPE VS MASTER PLAN VALIDATION         =========================================================*/          AND         (             /* Residential -> ONLY Residential */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Residential'                 AND o.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType = 'Residential'             )              OR              /* Commercial -> Residential OR Commercial */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Commercial'                 AND o.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType IN                     ('Residential', 'Commercial')             )              OR              /* Industrial -> Residential OR Industrial */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Industrial'                 AND o.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType IN                     ('Residential', 'Industrial')             )              OR              /* Mixed -> Residential OR Commercial */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Mixed'                 AND o.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType IN                     ('Residential', 'Commercial')             )         );           /*=========================================================           INDEX TEMP TABLE         =========================================================*/          CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_Apps_AppId         ON #Apps(App_Id);           /*=========================================================           STEP 2 : GET LATEST JC MOVED DATE         =========================================================*/          SELECT             s.Sts_MainAppId AS App_Id,             MAX(s.Udt) AS App_JCMovedDate          INTO #JCMovedDate          FROM dbo.BtoA_Status_Master_Tran s          INNER JOIN #Apps a             ON a.App_Id = s.Sts_MainAppId          WHERE             s.Sts_MainAppStatus in (14,1000)          GROUP BY             s.Sts_MainAppId          HAVING             MAX(s.Udt) < DATEADD(DAY, -13, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE));           /*=========================================================           INDEX JC TEMP TABLE         =========================================================*/          CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_JCMovedDate_AppId         ON #JCMovedDate(App_Id);           /*=========================================================           STEP 3 : INSERT ONLY NEW ELIGIBLE APPLICATIONS            ApplicationDisplayID already existing in target table           will NOT be inserted.         =========================================================*/          INSERT INTO dbo.JC_Auto_Approved_SPA_Applications         (             ApplicationDisplayID,             MotherEPID,             Application_Status,             Corporation,             Zone,             Ward,             IsGovtProperty,             BtoA_RoadId,             BtoA_RoadName,             Road_ID,             Road_Name,             GuidanceValueSqMt,             PropertyUseType,             Application_JCMovedDate,             Application_type,             BtoA_RoadType,             IsMasterPlanMismatch,             SiteArea,             JC_Pending_Days,             CreatedDate,             OfficerName,             IsAutoApprovedManually         )          SELECT DISTINCT              a.App_DisplayId AS ApplicationDisplayID,              a.App_MotherEPID AS MotherEPID,              CASE                 WHEN a.App_Status  in (14,1000)                 THEN 'Pending with JC'                 ELSE ''             END AS Application_Status,              a.GBA AS Corporation,              a.MD_Zonename AS Zone,              a.MD_WardName AS Ward,              CASE                 WHEN ISNULL(a.Ofcr_IsGovtProperty, 0) = 0                 THEN 'NO'             END AS IsGovtProperty,              a.BtoA_RoadId,              a.BtoA_RoadName,              a.Road_ID,              a.Road_Name,              a.GuidanceValueSqMt,              a.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue AS PropertyUseType,              jc.App_JCMovedDate AS Application_JCMovedDate,              CASE                 WHEN a.App_Source <> 'newkhata'                 THEN 'B2A'             END AS Application_type,              'public' AS BtoA_RoadType,              'No' AS IsMasterPlanMismatch,              a.MD_SiteArea AS SiteArea,              DATEDIFF             (                 DAY,                 CAST(jc.App_JCMovedDate AS DATE),                 CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)             ) AS JC_Pending_Days,              GETDATE() AS CreatedDate,              jcOfficer.Ofcr_Name AS OfficerName,              0 AS IsAutoApprovedManually          FROM #Apps a          INNER JOIN #JCMovedDate jc             ON jc.App_Id = a.App_Id           /*=========================================================           GET ONE ACTIVE JC OFFICER FOR THE ZONE         =========================================================*/          OUTER APPLY         (             SELECT TOP 1                 ofc.Ofcr_Name,                 ofc.Ofcr_Id              FROM masterDB_prod.dbo.mst_officer ofc              WHERE                 ofc.Ofcr_ZoneId = a.MD_ZoneId                 AND ofc.Ofcr_RoleId = 125                 AND ofc.Ofcr_Active = 1                 AND ofc.Ofcr_Id NOT IN (65, 11240, 11241)              ORDER BY                 ofc.Ofcr_Id          ) jcOfficer           WHERE          /*=========================================================           1. MUST HAVE AT LEAST ONE ROAD         =========================================================*/          EXISTS         (             SELECT 1              FROM dbo.BtoA_SiteRoadDetails_Officer r              WHERE r.BtoA_MainAppId = a.App_Id         )           /*=========================================================           2. ALL ROADS MUST BE PUBLIC         =========================================================*/          AND NOT EXISTS         (             SELECT 1              FROM dbo.BtoA_SiteRoadDetails_Officer r              WHERE r.BtoA_MainAppId = a.App_Id              AND             (                 r.BtoA_RoadType IS NULL                 OR LTRIM(RTRIM(r.BtoA_RoadType)) = ''                 OR LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(r.BtoA_RoadType))) <> 'public'             )         )           /*=========================================================           3. EVERY ROAD MUST MATCH KSRAC         =========================================================*/          AND NOT EXISTS         (             SELECT 1              FROM dbo.BtoA_SiteRoadDetails_Officer r              WHERE r.BtoA_MainAppId = a.App_Id              AND NOT EXISTS             (                 SELECT 1                  FROM masterDB_prod.dbo.mst_AROMapping aro                  INNER JOIN masterDB_prod.dbo.MstRoadKSRAC k                     ON k.GBAZONEID = aro.GBAZONEID                     AND k.BBMPWardId = aro.BBMPWardId                     AND k.Road_Active = 1                  WHERE                     aro.GBAZONEID = a.MD_ZoneId                     AND aro.BBMPWardId = a.MD_WardId                     AND aro.BBMPStreetId = a.MD_StreetId                     AND aro.easthiULBNAME_CorpId = a.GBAId                     AND k.GuidanceValueSqMt IS NOT NULL                     AND k.Road_ID = r.BtoA_RoadId                     AND LTRIM(RTRIM(k.Road_Name))                         = LTRIM(RTRIM(r.BtoA_RoadName))             )         )           /*=========================================================           4. EXCLUDE GOVERNMENT PROPERTY         =========================================================*/          AND ISNULL(a.Ofcr_IsGovtProperty, 0) = 0           /*=========================================================           5. EXCLUDE GOOGLE GOVERNMENT PROPERTY         =========================================================*/          AND NOT EXISTS         (             SELECT 1              FROM dbo.BtoA_SiteDtls s              WHERE s.Site_App_Id = a.App_Id              AND ISNULL(s.GooglePropertyType, '') = 'govt'         )           /*=========================================================           PREVENT DUPLICATE INSERTS         =========================================================*/          AND NOT EXISTS         (             SELECT 1             FROM dbo.JC_Auto_Approved_SPA_Applications j              WHERE j.ApplicationDisplayID = a.App_DisplayId               AND ISNULL(j.MotherEPID, '') = ISNULL(a.App_MotherEPID, '')         );

column8: CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[USP_GetPaymentReport_ByAppID] --27187,1,1 (     @AppID INT,     @cby   INT = 0,     @crole INT = 0 ) AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON;      /* =========================================================        STEP 0 : BASIC VARIABLES        ========================================================= */      DECLARE         @numberofRoadFacing INT = 0,         @PaymentDate DATETIME = GETDATE(),         @GuidenceValueinSqMt FLOAT = 0,          @ResArea FLOAT,         @ComArea FLOAT,         @IndArea FLOAT,          @PropertyUseTypeId INT,         @EPID nvarchar(30),         @dcConversionValue FLOAT = 0,         @penaltyMultiplier INT = 2,         @DCWithPenalty FLOAT = 0,         @dcRes FLOAT = 0,         @dcNonRes FLOAT = 0,          @ErrMsg NVARCHAR(500) = NULL,         @FinalGV FLOAT,         @AppDisplayId VARCHAR(50),         @IsGovtLand BIT,          @DCValue DECIMAL(18,2);       DECLARE @ReportSource NVARCHAR(50) = N'CALCULATED_IN_MEMORY';      DECLARE @Result TABLE     (         RowId INT IDENTITY(1,1),          PropertyTypeId INT,         PropertyType NVARCHAR(50),         FeesName NVARCHAR(200),                  TotalAreaInSqMt FLOAT,         Amount FLOAT,         Discount FLOAT,         NetAmount FLOAT,          Multiplier FLOAT,         Percentagee FLOAT,          StepNameId INT,         StepName NVARCHAR(100),          GuidenceValue FLOAT,         Message NVARCHAR(500)     );      /* =========================================================        STEP 1 : CHECK APPLICATION STATUS        ONLY APP_STATUS = 150 IS ALLOWED        ========================================================= */      IF NOT EXISTS     (         SELECT 1         FROM dbo.BtoAMainApp         WHERE App_Id = @AppID           AND App_Status = 150     )     BEGIN         SELECT @AppDisplayId = App_DisplayId         FROM dbo.BtoAMainApp         WHERE App_Id = @AppID;          SET @ErrMsg = 'Payment report is available only for App_Status = 150.';          INSERT INTO @Result         VALUES         (NULL, 'ALL', 'ERROR', NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 0, 'Validation', NULL, @ErrMsg);          GOTO FinalOutput;     END;       /* =========================================================        STEP 2 : IF PAYMENT ALREADY EXISTS        ---------------------------------        JUST SHOW EXISTING DATA.        NO RECALCULATION.        ========================================================= */     /* =========================================================    STEP 2 : IF PAYMENT ALREADY EXISTS    ---------------------------------------------------------    SHOW EXISTING PAYMENT DATA    NO PAYMENT TABLE UPDATE    NO PAYMENT RECALCULATION    ========================================================= */  IF EXISTS (     SELECT 1     FROM dbo.BtoA_FinalPaymentTrn     WHERE FPC_AppId = @AppID       AND FPC_Active = 1 ) BEGIN      SET @ReportSource = N'EXISTING_PAYMENT';       /* =====================================================        1. FETCH APPLICATION DETAILS        ===================================================== */      SELECT         @AppDisplayId = a.App_DisplayId,          @PropertyUseTypeId =             oa.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeId,          @ResArea =             oa.ResidentialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt,          @ComArea =             oa.CommercialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt,          @IndArea =             oa.IndustrialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt,          @numberofRoadFacing =             oa.Ofcr_RoadFacingSides,          @IsGovtLand =             oa.Ofcr_IsGovtProperty,          @EPID =             a.App_MotherEPID      FROM dbo.BtoAMainApp a      LEFT JOIN dbo.BtoA_MainApp_Officer oa         ON oa.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId = a.App_Id      WHERE a.App_Id = @AppID;       /* =====================================================        2. GET GUIDANCE VALUE        -----------------------------------------------------        Same source used by the manual calculation.        ===================================================== */      SELECT TOP 1          @GuidenceValueinSqMt =             mrk.GuidanceValueSqMt      FROM dbo.BtoA_SiteRoadDetails_Officer aso      INNER JOIN [masterDB_prod].dbo.MstRoadKSRAC mrk         ON aso.BtoA_RoadId = mrk.Road_ID         AND LTRIM(RTRIM(aso.BtoA_RoadName))            =            LTRIM(RTRIM(mrk.Road_Name))      WHERE aso.BtoA_MainAppId = @AppID        AND ISNULL(aso.IsRMPPropersed, 'N') = 'N'      ORDER BY         mrk.GuidanceValueSqMt DESC;       /* =====================================================        3. INSERT EXISTING PAYMENT INTO @RESULT        -----------------------------------------------------        Actual payment values come from        BtoA_FinalPaymentTrn.         GuidanceValue comes from the same Guidance Value        source used by the calculation.        ===================================================== */      INSERT INTO @Result     (         PropertyTypeId,         PropertyType,         FeesName,         TotalAreaInSqMt,         Amount,         Discount,         NetAmount,         Multiplier,         Percentagee,         StepNameId,         StepName,         GuidenceValue,         Message     )      SELECT          @PropertyUseTypeId,          CASE @PropertyUseTypeId             WHEN 1 THEN 'Commercial'             WHEN 2 THEN 'Residential'             WHEN 3 THEN 'Mixed'             WHEN 4 THEN 'Industrial'             ELSE 'ALL'         END,          p.FPC_Name,          CASE @PropertyUseTypeId             WHEN 1 THEN @ComArea             WHEN 2 THEN @ResArea              WHEN 3 THEN                 ISNULL(@ResArea,0)                 +                 ISNULL(@ComArea,0)              WHEN 4 THEN @IndArea         END,          /* Amount calculated */         p.FPC_AmountCalculated,          /* Discount / Rebate */         p.FPC_Rebate,          /* Final Net Amount */         p.FPC_NetAmount,          /* Multiplier used */         p.FPC_AreaMultiplierPerSqmt,          /* Percentage used */         p.FPC_PercentagePerSqmt,          /* Step */         p.FPC_StepId,          /* Step Name */         p.FPC_StepName,          /* =================================================            GUIDANCE VALUE            ================================================= */          CASE             WHEN p.FPC_StepId IN (0,1,2,3,4)                 THEN p.FPC_AmountCalculated             ELSE NULL         END,          /* Message */         ISNULL(             p.FPC_AdditionalInfo,             p.FPC_Desc         )      FROM dbo.BtoA_FinalPaymentTrn p      WHERE p.FPC_AppId = @AppID       AND p.FPC_Active = 1;       /* =====================================================        4. GO DIRECTLY TO FINAL OUTPUT        ===================================================== */      GOTO FinalOutput;  END;       /* =========================================================        STEP 4 : FETCH APPLICATION DATA        ========================================================= */      SELECT         @numberofRoadFacing = oa.Ofcr_RoadFacingSides,         @ResArea = oa.ResidentialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt,         @ComArea = oa.CommercialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt,         @IndArea = oa.IndustrialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt,         @PropertyUseTypeId = oa.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeId,         @GuidenceValueinSqMt = gv.GuidanceValueSqMt,         @AppDisplayId = oa.ApplicationDisplayId,         @IsGovtLand = oa.Ofcr_IsGovtProperty,         @EPID = a.App_MotherEPID     FROM dbo.BtoAMainApp a      LEFT JOIN dbo.BtoA_MainApp_Officer oa         ON a.App_Id = oa.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId      LEFT JOIN     (         SELECT TOP 1             mrk.GuidanceValueSqMt,             @AppID AS AppId          FROM dbo.BtoA_SiteRoadDetails_Officer aso          INNER JOIN [masterDB_prod].dbo.MstRoadKSRAC mrk             ON aso.BtoA_RoadId = mrk.Road_ID            AND LTRIM(RTRIM(aso.BtoA_RoadName))                = LTRIM(RTRIM(mrk.Road_Name))          WHERE aso.BtoA_MainAppId = @AppID           AND ISNULL(aso.IsRMPPropersed, 'N') = 'N'          ORDER BY             mrk.GuidanceValueSqMt DESC     ) gv         ON a.App_Id = gv.AppId      WHERE a.App_Id = @AppID;       /* =========================================================        STEP 5 : APPLICATION EXCLUSION VALIDATION        ========================================================= */      IF EXISTS     (         SELECT 1         FROM dbo.BtoAMainApp a         WHERE a.App_MotherEPID IN         (             '3577804758',             '3445675546',             '3444517696',             '3444536028',             '3444021054',             '3444150754'         )         AND a.App_Id IN         (             7918,             7932,             7997,             7998,             10381,             11782         )         AND a.App_Id = @AppID     )     BEGIN          SET @ErrMsg =             'Payment cannot be done. Please contact the helpdesk for more details';          INSERT INTO @Result         VALUES         (             @PropertyUseTypeId,             'ALL',             'ERROR',             NULL,             NULL,             NULL,             NULL,             NULL,             NULL,             0,             'Validation',             NULL,             @ErrMsg         );              GOTO FinalOutput;     END;       /* =========================================================        STEP 6 : ROAD NAME MISMATCH VALIDATION        ========================================================= */      IF EXISTS     (         SELECT 1         FROM dbo.BtoA_SiteRoadDetails_Officer aso          INNER JOIN dbo.BtoAMainApp b             ON aso.BtoA_MainAppId = b.App_Id          WHERE aso.BtoA_MainAppId = @AppID           AND ISNULL(aso.IsRMPPropersed, 'N') = 'N'           AND b.App_Active = 1     )     AND NOT EXISTS     (         SELECT 1         FROM dbo.BtoA_SiteRoadDetails_Officer aso          INNER JOIN [masterDB_prod].dbo.MstRoadKSRAC mrk             ON aso.BtoA_RoadId = mrk.Road_ID            AND LTRIM(RTRIM(aso.BtoA_RoadName))                = LTRIM(RTRIM(mrk.Road_Name))          WHERE aso.BtoA_MainAppId = @AppID           AND ISNULL(aso.IsRMPPropersed, 'N') = 'N'     )     BEGIN          SET @ErrMsg =             'Action Required. Please wait for 5 to 6 days for this issue to be resolved. '             + 'If the issue persists after 5 to 6 days, please contact the helpdesk '             + 'for further assistance. Application ID: '             + ISNULL(@AppDisplayId,'');          INSERT INTO @Result         VALUES         (             @PropertyUseTypeId,             'ALL',             'ERROR',             NULL,             NULL,             NULL,             NULL,             NULL,             NULL,             0,             'Validation',             NULL,             @ErrMsg         );              GOTO FinalOutput;     END;       /* =========================================================        STEP 7 : GOVERNMENT LAND VALIDATION        ========================================================= */      IF ISNULL(@IsGovtLand,0) = 1     BEGIN          SET @ErrMsg =             'Payment is disabled because the property has been identified as Government Land. '             + 'Please contact the support team for further assistance.';          INSERT INTO @Result         VALUES         (             @PropertyUseTypeId,             'ALL',             'ERROR',             NULL,             NULL,             NULL,             NULL,             NULL,             NULL,             0,             'Validation',             NULL,             @ErrMsg         );              GOTO FinalOutput;     END;       /* =========================================================        STEP 8 : GUIDANCE VALUE VALIDATION        ========================================================= */      IF ISNULL(@GuidenceValueinSqMt,0) = 0     BEGIN          SET @ErrMsg =             'Action Required, Guidance value for this property is not available. '             + 'Your application is with Joint Commissioner to enter the same. '             + 'Application ID:'             + ISNULL(@AppDisplayId,'');          INSERT INTO @Result         VALUES         (             @PropertyUseTypeId,             'ALL',             'ERROR',             NULL,             NULL,             NULL,             NULL,             NULL,             NULL,             0,             'Validation',             NULL,             @ErrMsg         );              GOTO FinalOutput;     END;       /* =========================================================        STEP 9 : AREA VALIDATION        ========================================================= */      IF @PropertyUseTypeId = 3        AND        (            @ComArea IS NULL            OR @ComArea = 0            OR @ResArea IS NULL            OR @ResArea = 0        )     BEGIN          SET @ErrMsg = 'Something went wrong';          INSERT INTO @Result         VALUES         (             @PropertyUseTypeId,             'ALL',             'ERROR',             NULL,             NULL,             NULL,             NULL,             NULL,             NULL,             0,             'Validation',             NULL,             @ErrMsg         );              GOTO FinalOutput;     END;       IF @PropertyUseTypeId = 1        AND        (            @ComArea IS NULL            OR @ComArea = 0        )     BEGIN          SET @ErrMsg = 'Something went wrong';          INSERT INTO @Result         VALUES         (             @PropertyUseTypeId,             'ALL',             'ERROR',             NULL,             NULL,             NULL,             NULL,             NULL,             NULL,             0,             'Validation',             NULL,             @ErrMsg         );              GOTO FinalOutput;     END;       IF @PropertyUseTypeId = 2        AND        (            @ResArea IS NULL            OR @ResArea = 0        )     BEGIN          SET @ErrMsg = 'Something went wrong';          INSERT INTO @Result         VALUES         (             @PropertyUseTypeId,             'ALL',             'ERROR',             NULL,             NULL,             NULL,             NULL,             NULL,             NULL,             0,             'Validation',             NULL,             @ErrMsg         );              GOTO FinalOutput;     END;       IF @PropertyUseTypeId = 4        AND        (            @IndArea IS NULL            OR @IndArea = 0        )     BEGIN          SET @ErrMsg = 'Something went wrong';          INSERT INTO @Result         VALUES         (             @PropertyUseTypeId,             'ALL',             'ERROR',             NULL,             NULL,             NULL,             NULL,             NULL,             NULL,             0,             'Validation',             NULL,             @ErrMsg         ); column8: ALTER PROCEDURE [dbo].[USP_Ward_Consolidated_status_Report_Update] AS BEGIN    SET NOCOUNT ON;    /* ============================================================    CLEANUP TEMP TABLES    ============================================================ */    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #BASE;    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #PAYMENT_DATA;    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #ROLE125;    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #ROLE130_CURR;    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #ROLE130_HIST;    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #STATUS_AGG;    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #AGGREGATED;    DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #FINAL_DATA;    /* ============================================================    BASE DATA    ============================================================ */    SELECT DISTINCT a.App_Id,       a.App_DisplayId AS ApplicationId,       a.GBA,       a.GBAId,       b.MD_ZoneId,       LTRIM(RTRIM( REPLACE( REPLACE(ISNULL(b.MD_Zonename, ''), CHAR(160), ' '), CHAR(9), ' ' ) )) AS MD_Zonename,       b.MD_WardId,       LTRIM(RTRIM( REPLACE( REPLACE( REPLACE( REPLACE( REPLACE( ISNULL(b.MD_WardName, ''), CHAR(160), ' ' -- Non-breaking space -> normal space       ), CHAR(9), ' '                                                                                     -- Tab -> space       ), '  ', ' '                                                                                        -- Pass 1       ), '  ', ' '                                                                                        -- Pass 2       ), '  ', ' '                                                                                        -- Pass 3       ) )) AS MD_WardName,       a.App_Status,       a.App_IsPushedToEaasthi,       a.App_Source,       a.App_MotherEPID,       a.isFinalPaymentDone,       a.finalPaymentDate,       CASE          WHEN             a.App_Source = 'newkhata'          THEN 'NEWKHATA'          ELSE 'OTHER'       END AS SourceType    INTO #BASE    FROM dbo.BtoAMainApp a WITH (NOLOCK)    INNER JOIN dbo.BtoA_EPIDMetaData b WITH (NOLOCK) ON a.App_Id = b.MD_APP_ID    WHERE a.App_Active                   = 1    AND ISNULL(a.isProcessingFeePaid, 0) = 1    AND a.App_Status                     >= 10    AND ISNULL(a.IsPushedToGps, 0)       = 1;    /* Clustered index for the payment join (App_Id is unique per #BASE row) */ CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_BASE_AppId ON #BASE (App_Id); /* Covering non-clustered index for all the GROUP BY work below. This replaces the old #BASE_UNIQUE table+clustered-index copy. */ CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_BASE_Grouping ON #BASE    (       GBAId,       MD_ZoneId,       MD_WardId,       SourceType    ) INCLUDE    (       App_Id,       GBA,       MD_Zonename,       MD_WardName,       App_Status,       App_Source,       App_IsPushedToEaasthi,       isFinalPaymentDone,       finalPaymentDate    ) ; /* ============================================================ PAYMENT DATA ============================================================ */ SELECT f.FPC_AppId AS App_Id,    SUM(ISNULL(f.FPC_AmountCalculated, 0)) AS Payment_Amount INTO #PAYMENT_DATA FROM dbo.BtoA_FinalPaymentTrn f WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE f.FPC_Active      = 1 AND f.FPC_Pay_Isdisplay = 1 GROUP BY f.FPC_AppId; CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_PAYMENT_DATA_AppId ON #PAYMENT_DATA (App_Id); /* ============================================================ MAIN AGGREGATION (counts, payments) - grain: GBA/Zone/Ward/SourceType ============================================================ */ SELECT a.GBA,    a.GBAId,    a.MD_ZoneId,    a.MD_Zonename,    a.MD_WardId,    a.MD_WardName,    a.SourceType,    COUNT(*) AS Total_Citizens,    SUM( CASE WHEN a.App_Status IN (13, 16, 18) AND ISNULL(a.App_Source, '') <> 'newkhata' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Sketch_Pending,    SUM( CASE WHEN a.App_Status IN (13, 16, 18) AND a.App_Source = 'newkhata' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CaseWorker_Pending,    SUM( CASE WHEN a.App_Status IN (1000, 1110) AND a.App_Source = 'newkhata' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS CaseWorker_Completed,    SUM( CASE WHEN a.App_Status IN (14, 1000, 1110) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS JC_Pending,    SUM( CASE WHEN a.App_Status IN (150, 1500, 1100, 1111, 200, 300) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS JC_Completed,    SUM( CASE WHEN ISNULL(a.isFinalPaymentDone, 0) = 1 AND ISNULL(a.App_IsPushedToEaasthi, 0) = 0 AND a.App_Status = 300 AND a.finalPaymentDate <= DATEADD(DAY, -3, GETDATE()) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PaymentPendingEaasthi,    SUM( CASE WHEN ISNULL(a.App_IsPushedToEaasthi, 0) = 1 AND ISNULL(a.App_Source, '') <> 'newkhata' AND a.App_Status <> 11 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS BtoAConvertedCount,    SUM( CASE WHEN ISNULL(a.App_IsPushedToEaasthi, 0) = 1 AND a.App_Source = 'newkhata' AND a.App_Status <> 11 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SPACount,    SUM( CASE WHEN a.App_Status IN (1500, 1100) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Commissioner_Pending,    SUM( CASE WHEN ISNULL(a.isFinalPaymentDone, 0) = 1 AND a.App_Status = 300 AND p.App_Id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Payment_Count,    SUM( CASE WHEN ISNULL(a.isFinalPaymentDone, 0) = 1 AND a.App_Status = 300 THEN ISNULL(p.Payment_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS Payment_Amount INTO #AGGREGATED FROM #BASE a LEFT JOIN #PAYMENT_DATA p ON a.App_Id = p.App_Id GROUP BY a.GBA,    a.GBAId,    a.MD_ZoneId,    a.MD_Zonename,    a.MD_WardId,    a.MD_WardName,    a.SourceType; --CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_AGGREGATED_Grouping ON #AGGREGATED (GBAId, MD_ZoneId, MD_WardId, SourceType); /* ============================================================ ROLE-BASED FLAGS - built ONCE from the transaction tables, instead of a correlated EXISTS re-run per metric. ============================================================ */ SELECT DISTINCT Sts_MainAppId AS App_Id INTO #ROLE125 FROM dbo.BtoA_Status_Master_Tran WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId = 125; CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_ROLE125 ON #ROLE125 (App_Id); SELECT DISTINCT Sts_MainAppId AS App_Id INTO #ROLE130_CURR FROM dbo.BtoA_Status_Master_Tran WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId = 130; CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_ROLE130_CURR ON #ROLE130_CURR (App_Id); SELECT DISTINCT Sts_MainAppId AS App_Id INTO #ROLE130_HIST FROM dbo.BtoA_Status_Master_Tran_hist WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId = 130 AND Sts_MainAppStatus IN (200,                           300); CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_ROLE130_HIST ON #ROLE130_HIST (App_Id); /* ============================================================ STATUS-DERIVED METRICS - single pass replaces #JC_REJECTED + #COMM_COMPLETED + #COMM_REJECTED ============================================================ */ SELECT a.GBA,    a.GBAId,    a.MD_ZoneId,    a.MD_Zonename,    a.MD_WardId,    a.MD_WardName,    a.SourceType,    SUM( CASE WHEN a.App_Status = 110 AND r125.App_Id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS JC_REJECTED,    SUM( CASE WHEN a.App_Status IN (200, 300) AND ( r130h.App_Id IS NOT NULL OR r130c.App_Id IS NOT NULL) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Commissioner_Completed,    SUM( CASE WHEN a.App_Status = 1111 AND r130c.App_Id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS COMM_REJECTED INTO #STATUS_AGG FROM #BASE a LEFT JOIN #ROLE125 r125 ON a.App_Id = r125.App_Id LEFT JOIN #ROLE130_CURR r130c ON a.App_Id = r130c.App_Id LEFT JOIN #ROLE130_HIST r130h ON a.App_Id = r130h.App_Id WHERE a.App_Status IN (110,                        200,                        300,                        1111) GROUP BY a.GBA,    a.GBAId,    a.MD_ZoneId,    a.MD_Zonename,    a.MD_WardId,    a.MD_WardName,    a.SourceType; CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_STATUS_AGG_Grouping ON #STATUS_AGG (GBAId, MD_ZoneId, MD_WardId, SourceType); /* ============================================================ FINAL DATA  ============================================================ */ SELECT a.GBA,    a.GBAId,    a.MD_ZoneId,    a.MD_Zonename,    a.MD_WardId,    a.MD_WardName,    a.SourceType,    a.Total_Citizens,    a.Sketch_Pending,    a.CaseWorker_Pending,    a.CaseWorker_Completed,    a.JC_Pending,    a.JC_Completed,    ISNULL(s.JC_REJECTED, 0) AS JC_REJECTED,    ISNULL(s.Commissioner_Completed, 0) AS Commissioner_Completed,    a.Commissioner_Pending,    ISNULL(s.COMM_REJECTED, 0) AS COMM_REJECTED,    a.Payment_Count,    a.Payment_Amount,    a.PaymentPendingEaasthi AS [BtoA/SPA Yet to be Pushed to eAasthi (>3 Days)],    a.BtoAConvertedCount,    a.SPACount INTO #FINAL_DATA FROM #AGGREGATED a LEFT JOIN #STATUS_AGG s ON a.GBAId = s.GBAId AND a.MD_ZoneId  = s.MD_ZoneId AND a.MD_WardId  = s.MD_WardId AND a.SourceType = s.SourceType; /* ============================================================ FINAL RESULT - one GROUPING SETS pass produces: - per ward, per SourceType   (ReportType = NEWKHATA / OTHER) - per ward, both sources     (ReportType = TOTAL) - grand total per SourceType (GBA = 'Total') - overall grand total        (GBA = 'Total', ReportType = TOTAL) This replaces #FINAL_OUTPUT + the 2 INSERTs + the 4-way UNION ALL.    /* Clustered index for the payment join (App_Id is unique per #BASE row) */ CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_BASE_AppId ON #BASE (App_Id); /* Covering non-clustered index for all the GROUP BY work below. This replaces the old #BASE_UNIQUE table+clustered-index copy. */ CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IX_BASE_Grouping ON #BASE    (       GBAId,       MD_ZoneId,       MD_WardId,       SourceType    ) INCLUDE    (       App_Id,       GBA,       MD_Zonename,       MD_WardName,       App_Status,       App_Source,       App_IsPushedToEaasthi,       isFinalPaymentDone,       finalPaymentDate    ) ; /* ============================================================ PAYMENT DATA ============================================================ */ SELECT f.FPC_AppId AS App_Id,    SUM(ISNULL(f.FPC_AmountCalculated, 0)) AS Payment_Amount INTO #PAYMENT_DATA FROM dbo.BtoA_FinalPaymentTrn f WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE f.FPC_Active      = 1 AND f.FPC_Pay_Isdisplay = 1 GROUP BY f.FPC_AppId; CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_PAYMENT_DATA_AppId ON #PAYMENT_DATA (App_Id); /* ============================================================ MAIN AGGREGATION (counts, payments) - grain: GBA/Zone/Ward/SourceType ============================================================ */ SELECT a.GBA,    a.GBAId,    a.MD_ZoneId,    a.MD_Zonename,    a.MD_WardId,    a.MD_WardName,    a.SourceType,    COUNT(*) AS Total_Citizens,    SUM( CASE WHEN a.App_Status IN (13, 16, 18) AND ISNULL(a.App_Source, '') <> 'newkhata' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Sketch_Pending,    SUM( CASE WHEN a.App_Status IN (13, 16, WHEN ISNULL(a.App_IsPushedToEaasthi, 0) = 1 AND a.App_Source = 'newkhata' AND a.App_Status <> 11 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SPACount,    SUM( CASE WHEN a.App_Status IN (1500, 1100) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ============================================================ */ SELECT a.GBA,    a.GBAId,    a.MD_ZoneId,    a.MD_Zonename,    a.MD_WardId,    a.MD_WardName,    a.SourceType,    a.Total_Citizens, Commissioner_Completed,    a.Commissioner_Pending,    ISNULL(s.COMM_REJECTED, 0) AS COMM_REJECTED,    a.Payment_Count,    a.Payment_Amount,    a.PaymentPendingEaasthi AS [BtoA/SPA Yet to be Pushed to s.MD_WardId AND a.SourceType = s.SourceType; /* ============================================================ FINAL RESULT - one GROUPING SETS pass produces: - per ward, per SourceType   (ReportType = NEWKHATA / OTHER) - per ward, both sources     (ReportType = TOTAL) - grand total per SourceType (GBA = 'Total') - overall grand total        (GBA = 'Total', ReportType = TOTAL) This replaces #FINAL_OUTPUT + the 2 INSERTs + the 4-way UNION ALL. column8: ALTER PROCEDURE [dbo].[USP_JC_AutoApprove_SPA_Applications] AS BEGIN      SET NOCOUNT ON;     SET XACT_ABORT ON;      BEGIN TRY          BEGIN TRANSACTION;          /*=========================================================           STEP 0 : DROP TEMP TABLES         =========================================================*/          DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Apps;         DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #JCMovedDate;           /*=========================================================           STEP 1 : GET BASE ELIGIBLE APPLICATIONS         =========================================================*/          SELECT             a.App_Id,             a.App_DisplayId,             a.App_Status,             a.GBA,             a.GBAId,             a.App_MotherEPID,             a.App_Source,              ofi.BtoA_RoadId,             ofi.BtoA_RoadName,              ksr.Road_ID,             ksr.Road_Name,             ksr.GuidanceValueSqMt,              /* EPID Metadata */             b.MD_Zonename,             b.MD_WardName,             b.MD_SiteArea,             b.MD_ZoneId,             b.MD_WardId,             b.MD_StreetId,              /* Officer Details */             o.Ofcr_IsGovtProperty,             o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue,             o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeId,             o.Ofcr_RoadFacingSides,             o.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType          INTO #Apps          FROM dbo.BtoAMainApp a          INNER JOIN dbo.BtoA_EPIDMetaData b             ON b.MD_APP_ID = a.App_Id          INNER JOIN         (             SELECT                 Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId,                 Ofcr_IsGovtProperty,                 Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue,                 Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeId,                 Ofcr_RoadFacingSides,                 ResidentialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt,                 CommercialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt,                 IndustrialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt,                 KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType             FROM dbo.BtoA_MainApp_Officer         ) o             ON o.Ofcr_BtoA_MainAppId = a.App_Id          INNER JOIN dbo.BtoA_SiteRoadDetails_Officer ofi             ON ofi.BtoA_MainAppId = a.App_Id          INNER JOIN masterDB_prod.dbo.MstRoadKSRAC ksr             ON ofi.BtoA_RoadId = ksr.Road_ID          /* JC Officer eligibility */         INNER JOIN masterDB_prod.dbo.mst_officer ofc             ON b.MD_ZoneId = ofc.Ofcr_ZoneId          WHERE             a.App_Active = 1             AND a.App_Status in (14,1000)             AND ofc.Ofcr_RoleId = 125             AND ofc.Ofcr_Active = 1             AND a.App_Source = 'newkhata'             AND b.MD_SiteArea >= 50             AND b.MD_SiteArea <= 1000             AND ISNULL(ofi.IsRMPPropersed, 'N') = 'N'             AND ksr.GuidanceValueSqMt IS NOT NULL 			AND a.App_JCApprovedDate is not null             AND a.App_JCApprovedDate < DATEADD(DAY, -13, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))             AND ofc.Ofcr_Id NOT IN (65, 11240, 11241)             AND ISNULL(a.IsApp_PropertyVerificationRequired, 0) = 0          /*=========================================================           ROAD-WIDENING AREA VALIDATION         =========================================================*/          AND         (             /* Commercial */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeId = 1                 AND ISNULL(o.CommercialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt, 0) > 5             )              OR              /* Residential */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeId = 2                 AND ISNULL(o.ResidentialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt, 0) > 5             )              OR              /* Mixed - BOTH areas must be greater than 5 */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeId = 3                 AND ISNULL(o.CommercialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt, 0) > 5                 AND ISNULL(o.ResidentialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt, 0) > 5             )              OR              /* Industrial */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeId = 4                 AND ISNULL(o.IndustrialPlotareaAfterRoadWideninginSqmt, 0) > 5             )         )          /*=========================================================           PROPERTY USE TYPE VS MASTER PLAN VALIDATION         =========================================================*/          AND         (             /* Residential -> ONLY Residential */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Residential'                 AND o.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType = 'Residential'             )              OR              /* Commercial -> Residential OR Commercial */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Commercial'                 AND o.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType IN                     ('Residential', 'Commercial')             )              OR              /* Industrial -> Residential OR Industrial */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Industrial'                 AND o.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType IN                     ('Residential', 'Industrial')             )              OR              /* Mixed -> Residential OR Commercial */             (                 o.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue = 'Mixed'                 AND o.KSRSACMasterPlanLandUseType IN                     ('Residential', 'Commercial')             )         );           /*=========================================================           INDEX TEMP TABLE         =========================================================*/          CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_Apps_AppId         ON #Apps(App_Id);           /*=========================================================           STEP 2 : GET LATEST JC MOVED DATE         =========================================================*/          SELECT             s.Sts_MainAppId AS App_Id,             MAX(s.Udt) AS App_JCMovedDate          INTO #JCMovedDate          FROM dbo.BtoA_Status_Master_Tran s          INNER JOIN #Apps a             ON a.App_Id = s.Sts_MainAppId          WHERE             s.Sts_MainAppStatus in (14,1000)          GROUP BY             s.Sts_MainAppId          HAVING             MAX(s.Udt) < DATEADD(DAY, -13, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE));           /*=========================================================           INDEX JC TEMP TABLE         =========================================================*/          CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_JCMovedDate_AppId         ON #JCMovedDate(App_Id);           /*=========================================================           STEP 3 : INSERT ONLY NEW ELIGIBLE APPLICATIONS            ApplicationDisplayID already existing in target table           will NOT be inserted.         =========================================================*/          --INSERT INTO dbo.JC_Auto_Approved_SPA_Applications         --(         --    ApplicationDisplayID,         --    MotherEPID,         --    Application_Status,         --    Corporation,         --    Zone,         --    Ward,         --    IsGovtProperty,         --    BtoA_RoadId,         --    BtoA_RoadName,         --    Road_ID,         --    Road_Name,         --    GuidanceValueSqMt,         --    PropertyUseType,         --    Application_JCMovedDate,         --    Application_type,         --    BtoA_RoadType,         --    IsMasterPlanMismatch,         --    SiteArea,         --    JC_Pending_Days,         --    CreatedDate,         --    OfficerName,         --    IsAutoApprovedManually         --)          SELECT DISTINCT              a.App_DisplayId AS ApplicationDisplayID,              a.App_MotherEPID AS MotherEPID,              CASE                 WHEN a.App_Status  in (14,1000)                 THEN 'Pending with JC'                 ELSE ''             END AS Application_Status,              a.GBA AS Corporation,              a.MD_Zonename AS Zone,              a.MD_WardName AS Ward,              CASE                 WHEN ISNULL(a.Ofcr_IsGovtProperty, 0) = 0                 THEN 'NO'             END AS IsGovtProperty,              a.BtoA_RoadId,              a.BtoA_RoadName,              a.Road_ID,              a.Road_Name,              a.GuidanceValueSqMt,              a.Ofcr_CorrectedPropertyUseTypeValue AS PropertyUseType,              jc.App_JCMovedDate AS Application_JCMovedDate,              CASE                 WHEN a.App_Source <> 'newkhata'                 THEN 'B2A'             END AS Application_type,              'public' AS BtoA_RoadType,              'No' AS IsMasterPlanMismatch,              a.MD_SiteArea AS SiteArea,              DATEDIFF             (                 DAY,                 CAST(jc.App_JCMovedDate AS DATE),                 CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)             ) AS JC_Pending_Days,              GETDATE() AS CreatedDate,              jcOfficer.Ofcr_Name AS OfficerName,              0 AS IsAutoApprovedManually          FROM #Apps a          INNER JOIN #JCMovedDate jc             ON jc.App_Id = a.App_Id           /*=========================================================           GET ONE ACTIVE JC OFFICER FOR THE ZONE         =========================================================*/          OUTER APPLY         (             SELECT TOP 1                 ofc.Ofcr_Name,                 ofc.Ofcr_Id              FROM masterDB_prod.dbo.mst_officer ofc              WHERE                 ofc.Ofcr_ZoneId = a.MD_ZoneId                 AND ofc.Ofcr_RoleId = 125                 AND ofc.Ofcr_Active = 1                 AND ofc.Ofcr_Id NOT IN (65, 11240, 11241)              ORDER BY                 ofc.Ofcr_Id          ) jcOfficer           WHERE          /*=========================================================           1. MUST HAVE AT LEAST ONE ROAD         =========================================================*/          EXISTS         (             SELECT 1              FROM dbo.BtoA_SiteRoadDetails_Officer r              WHERE r.BtoA_MainAppId = a.App_Id         )           /*=========================================================           2. ALL ROADS MUST BE PUBLIC         =========================================================*/          AND NOT EXISTS         (             SELECT 1              FROM dbo.BtoA_SiteRoadDetails_Officer r              WHERE r.BtoA_MainAppId = a.App_Id              AND             (                 r.BtoA_RoadType IS NULL                 OR LTRIM(RTRIM(r.BtoA_RoadType)) = ''                 OR LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(r.BtoA_RoadType))) <> 'public'             )         )           /*=========================================================           3. EVERY ROAD MUST MATCH KSRAC         =========================================================*/          AND NOT EXISTS         (             SELECT 1              FROM dbo.BtoA_SiteRoadDetails_Officer r              WHERE r.BtoA_MainAppId = a.App_Id              AND NOT EXISTS             (                 SELECT 1                  FROM masterDB_prod.dbo.mst_AROMapping aro                  INNER JOIN masterDB_prod.dbo.MstRoadKSRAC k                     ON k.GBAZONEID = aro.GBAZONEID                     AND k.BBMPWardId = aro.BBMPWardId                     AND k.Road_Active = 1                  WHERE                     aro.GBAZONEID = a.MD_ZoneId                     AND aro.BBMPWardId = a.MD_WardId                     AND aro.BBMPStreetId = a.MD_StreetId                     AND aro.easthiULBNAME_CorpId = a.GBAId                     AND k.GuidanceValueSqMt IS NOT NULL                     AND k.Road_ID = r.BtoA_RoadId                     AND LTRIM(RTRIM(k.Road_Name))                         = LTRIM(RTRIM(r.BtoA_RoadName))             )         )           /*=========================================================           4. EXCLUDE GOVERNMENT PROPERTY         =========================================================*/          AND ISNULL(a.Ofcr_IsGovtProperty, 0) = 0           /*=========================================================           5. EXCLUDE GOOGLE GOVERNMENT PROPERTY         =========================================================*/          AND NOT EXISTS         (             SELECT 1              FROM dbo.BtoA_SiteDtls s              WHERE s.Site_App_Id = a.App_Id              AND ISNULL(s.GooglePropertyType, '') = 'govt'         )           /*=========================================================           PREVENT DUPLICATE INSERTS         =========================================================*/          AND NOT EXISTS         (             SELECT 1             FROM dbo.JC_Auto_Approved_SPA_Applications j              WHERE j.ApplicationDisplayID = a.App_DisplayId               AND ISNULL(j.MotherEPID, '') = ISNULL(a.App_MotherEPID, '')         );           /*=========================================================           STEP 4 : UPDATE STATUS TRANSACTION            FINAL UPDATE 2            Source applications are identified ONLY from           JC_Auto_Approved_B2A_Applications         =========================================================*/          UPDATE s         SET             s.Sts_PrevStatusId = s.Sts_MainAppStatus,             s.Sts_MainAppStatus = 150,             s.Sts_CurrStatusId = 150,             s.Udt = GETDATE(),             s.Sts_comments = 'The application is auto-approved in JC Login',             s.Sts_PrevOfficerRoleId = s.Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId,             s.Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId = 125,             s.Sts_PrevOfficerId = s.Sts_CurrOfficerId          FROM dbo.BtoA_Status_Master_Tran s          INNER JOIN dbo.BtoAMainApp a             ON a.App_Id = s.Sts_MainAppId          INNER JOIN dbo.JC_Auto_Approved_SPA_Applications b             ON b.ApplicationDisplayID = a.App_DisplayId             AND ISNULL(b.MotherEPID, '') = ISNULL(a.App_MotherEPID, '')          WHERE             s.Sts_MainAppStatus in (14,1000) and a.App_Status in (14,1000)  and a.App_Source='newkhata';           /*=========================================================           STEP 5 : UPDATE MAIN APPLICATION            FINAL UPDATE 3            Source applications are identified ONLY from           JC_Auto_Approved_B2A_Applications         =========================================================*/          UPDATE a         SET             a.IsApp_JCAutoApproved = 1,             a.App_JCApprovedDate = GETDATE(),             a.App_AdditionalInfo =  'The application is auto-approved in JC Login',             a.App_Status = 150,             a.App_UDte = GETDATE(),             a.IsApp_MasterPlanMismatch = 0          FROM dbo.BtoAMainApp a          INNER JOIN dbo.JC_Auto_Approved_SPA_Applications b             ON b.ApplicationDisplayID = a.App_DisplayId             AND ISNULL(b.MotherEPID, '') =                 ISNULL(a.App_MotherEPID, '')          WHERE a.App_Status in (14,1000) and a.App_Source='newkhata';           /*=========================================================           STEP 6 : UPDATE TARGET TABLE            FINAL UPDATE 1            Update only records available in           JC_Auto_Approved_B2A_Applications         =========================================================*/  		UPDATE b 		SET  		    b.IsAutoApprovedManually = 1 		FROM dbo.JC_Auto_Approved_SPA_Applications b 		INNER JOIN dbo.BtoAMainApp a 		    ON a.App_DisplayId = b.ApplicationDisplayID 		    AND ISNULL(a.App_MotherEPID, '') = ISNULL(b.MotherEPID, '') 		WHERE  		ISNULL(b.IsAutoApprovedManually, 0) = 0 		AND b.CreatedDate >= CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) 		AND b.CreatedDate < DATEADD(DAY, 1, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)) 		AND a.App_Status = 150 		AND ISNULL(a.IsApp_JCAutoApproved, 0) = 1;          /*=========================================================           CLEANUP         =========================================================*/          DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #JCMovedDate;         DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #Apps;           COMMIT TRANSACTION;      END TRY      BEGIN CATCH          IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0             ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;          DECLARE @ErrorMessage NVARCHAR(4000);         DECLARE @ErrorSeverity INT;         DECLARE @ErrorState INT;          SELECT             @ErrorMessage = ERROR_MESSAGE(),             @ErrorSeverity = ERROR_SEVERITY(),             @ErrorState = ERROR_STATE();          RAISERROR         (             @ErrorMessage,             @ErrorSeverity,             @ErrorState         );      END CATCH;  	SELECT     a.App_Id,     a.App_DisplayId AS ApplicationDisplayID,     a.App_MotherEPID AS MotherEPID,     a.App_Status,     a.IsApp_JCAutoApproved,     a.App_JCApprovedDate,     a.App_UDte,     a.App_AdditionalInfo,     b.CreatedDate AS AutoApprovalCreatedDate,     b.IsAutoApprovedManually 	FROM dbo.BtoAMainApp a 	INNER JOIN dbo.JC_Auto_Approved_SPA_Applications b 	    ON a.App_DisplayId = b.ApplicationDisplayID 	    AND ISNULL(a.App_MotherEPID, '') = ISNULL(b.MotherEPID, '') 	WHERE a.App_Status = 150 	  AND ISNULL(a.IsApp_JCAutoApproved, 0) = 1 	  AND b.CreatedDate >= CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) 	  AND b.CreatedDate < DATEADD(DAY, 1, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE)) 	ORDER BY a.App_JCApprovedDate DESC;  END

column8: --exec USP_U_Status_Master_Tran 13203,13,11,0,'','Rejected Message display',1 ALTER PROCEDURE [dbo].[USP_U_Status_Master_Tran]     @MainApp_id BIGINT,     @Cby INT,     @Sts_MainAppStatus INT, 	@rejectedId INT, 	@rejectedText NVARCHAR(300), 	@comments NVARCHAR(MAX),     @Level INT AS BEGIN     SET NOCOUNT ON; 				 				 				IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0                 BEGIN 				print 'Current status details' 				print @Sts_MainAppStatus 				print @Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId                  				if(@Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId=125) 				begin 					if(@Sts_MainAppStatus=150) 					begin 					 SET @message = 'Application Approved'; 						SET @ResultStatus = 1;  						UPDATE BtoAMainApp  						SET App_Status = @Sts_MainAppStatus,  							App_UBy    = @Cby, 							App_UDte   = GETDATE() 						WHERE App_Id = @MainApp_id  						  AND App_Active = 1; 					 						UPDATE a set a.CompletedDate=getdate(), a.Status='Completed',a.UDate=GETDATE(), a.UBy=@Cby, a.URole=@Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId from BtoA_Architect_AssignedApp a inner join BtoAMainApp b on a.AppId=b.App_Id   						WHERE App_Id = @MainApp_id  AND App_Active = 1; 						 					End 					 				end 				else if(@Sts_CurrOfficerRoleId=116) 				begin 					  					if(@Sts_MainAppStatus=1000  ) 					begin 					 SET @message = 'Application successfully recommended for Approval to the Joint Commissioner.'; 					End 					  				end 				else 				begin                     SET @message = 'Status updated successfully';                     SET @ResultStatus = 1;                      UPDATE BtoAMainApp                      SET App_Status = @Sts_MainAppStatus,                          App_UBy    = @Cby,                         App_UDte   = GETDATE()                     WHERE App_Id = @MainApp_id                        AND App_Active = 1;
